original_config.outcome: Stationary primary: arithmetic mean of individual exact-covariance true_ratio_db at t=T=200. Measured heldout power remains the parameter-selection criterion. Moving records retain their original episode-averaged ratio definitions.
original_config.repetition_unit: Independent episode. Held-out snapshots average inside a checkpoint; moving primary outcomes average checkpoints inside the episode.
original_config.selection: Independent held-out measured disturbance power on disjoint validation episodes only; no true signature, covariance, oracle power or drift enters policy selection. Static beta=1. Moving mean/mode/isotropic share a mode-selected beta. Modal loading and loaded covariance select their own memory/loading. Sliding GREAT selects window/step/inner count; EW GREAT matches the shared Bingham beta and selects step/inner count.
original_config.great_ew_weights: Complex EW GREAT receives sqrt(eta_j/eta_initial)*u_j, eta_j=tau2_j/[sigma2_j*(sigma2_j+tau2_j)]. Its covariance matches the uncentered Bingham statistic up to the fixed positive factor eta_initial under the uniform prior. Fixed-variance data are unchanged; raw sliding-window GREAT retains the original residual objective.
original_config.variance_convention: Proper-complex covariance sigma2*I; real/imaginary component variances sigma2/2. Unit steering signatures give total interference power tau2.
original_config.motion: Identity transport for all primary unknown-motion comparisons. Baseline half-power desired/interference overlap is held exactly fixed across dimensions.
original_config.numerical_scope: Native complex rank-one means and normalizers only; no higher-rank, tail, interval or second-moment accuracy is inferred from these mean flags.
original_config.scale_information: This performance cohort conditions on the generating variances at correction/action time as a calibrated reference. The separate causal variance-learning cohort never receives future generating scales.
original_config.block_budget: Supplementary cadence/constant-state-block experiment uses 64 independent test episodes per motion at n=32,T=64. Primary stationary/moving performance cohorts retain 256. This smaller block cohort was selected from operation counts/native-mean preflight before any block task outcomes.
original_config.precision: Paper plan: 64 validation and 256 independent test episodes per primary cohort; all paired pointwise 95% intervals and achieved SEs retained. Broad grids are exploratory without multiplicity correction.

config.validation_criterion: Arithmetic mean across 64 validation simulations of 10*log10(w_200^H Rhat_validation,200 w_200); final time t=200 only, no oracle normalization, and no true covariance in selection.
config.tie_break: First beta in the original ordered grid, using minimum mean loss
config.information: Known generating sigma2=.2 and tau2=1; uniform Bingham initial parameter A0=0; identity transport; snapshot-only correction. Independent holdout covariances are measured observations, not true covariances.
config.no_retuning: Only the primary validation criterion selects beta. All secondary test aggregations are reported after selection, without reselection.
config.scope_note: Replays of the original observations and trajectories, not new cohorts. Original methods, settings, numerics, notebooks and exports are unchanged. This is independent posterior-mean selection under a different criterion; it is separate from the controlled common-parameter comparison.

difference_convention: Comparator minus posterior mean, paired by original trial ID; positive values favor the mean. Confidence intervals are pointwise Student 95% intervals across 256 independent original simulations, not simultaneous intervals.
